case_name: Hanmantu Nagappa Joglekar v State of Maharashtra and others

statutes.act: Ipc Which Requires A Participation By The Offenders In An Act

holding: The appropriate provision under which he could have been convicted is Section 323 read with Section 34 IPC or Section 114 IPC. He could have been convicted for a period not more than one year under the said provision.
cases_cited: Hanmantu Nagappa Joglekar v State of Maharashtra
